decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 22 March 2005, the erection of a hip to gable conversion measuring 2.8 metres perpendicular height, 3.7 metres wide and 8.2 metres deep and rear dormer measuring 5.5 metres wide, 2.7 metres high and 4.2 metres projection at top to property in two flats was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The property does not benefit from rights to extend under the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the property is occupied as two self-contained flats and therefore does not have the benefit of permitted development.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a roof extension comprising hip to gable conversion and rear dormer to property in two flats.
